admission.justification: Named phase limits make unanswered reader and sweep operations visible, and the test-owned selector lets the runner service queued completions when the socket wake-up is denied.

guarantee: The reader exchange and Git status observations and the sweep's session initialization, tool response and session cleanup have explicit limits. The sweep reports its own deadline as a named failure outside the product-raiser classification. Test-owned loops from the shared fixture factory also return from selector waits to service queued callbacks when a socket wake-up is denied, including while the runner joins its executor. The test-owned loops retain normal shutdown and require executor jobs to be able to finish. The fixtures' shared Git helpers git and init_repo in test_worktree_support.py and the sweep's _git remain outside the protocol timeout guarantee.
title: The reader and sweep protocol waits end at a limit
